title: Reviewed Adopter Workflow Steps
description: Complete optional adopter-owned reviewed step effects projected only by registered binding. Canonical YAML, exact occurrences and complete executable/import closure must match; no entry changes permissions or grants execution authority (ADR-SCR-0017).

workflow.description: Exact occurrence notation used by workflowStepInventory: <workflow file>#<job>[<step index>], comma-space separated for multiple occurrences. Semantic validation requires an exact bijection; a filename alone grants no trust.

files.description: Complete canonical path-sorted executable and import closure, including package-script/config/composite-action dependencies. Missing, extra, duplicate, changed, unreadable or escaping files refuse the reviewed effect.

computed_imports.description: Reviewed complete reachability covers for every computed import/require. Each named file must be pinned in files. An empty cover requires a truthful review that no repository file is reachable; unresolved dynamic reachability remains unknown.

path.description: Already-NFC repository-relative POSIX regular-file path. Semantic containment, symlink and duplicate-path checks are mandatory.
